atoms.b: Over time, rocks are ((++eroded deposited)) into smaller rocks and minerals.
These smaller rocks and minerals are moved by ((++water_and_wind humans)) and are ((++deposited eroded)) elsewhere.
The deposited rocks and minerals form layers that are called ((++sediments deposits)).
Over time, these layers fuse together to form ((++sedimentary_rocks metamorphic_rocks)).
